scripts.test:rules: npx --yes firebase-tools@15 emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-umnotho "node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.rules.config.ts"
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix functions run build && npx --yes firebase-tools@15 -c firebase.emulators.json emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-umnotho
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy:hosting: npm run build && npx --yes firebase-tools@15 deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx --yes firebase-tools@15 deploy --only hosting,firestore
scripts.deploy:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && npx --yes firebase-tools@15 -c firebase.functions.json deploy --only functions
scripts.deploy:all: npm run deploy && npm run deploy:functions
